title: Manyhands JSON v1 document mutation data
description: The data of a document create, document save or document move envelope. It may accompany any outcome: a success, a no-op, a partial result, and a rejection that is about the document. It never holds the document's title, body or source.

path.description: The file the request writes, relative to the document's context, with forward slashes: for a move, the destination. Null when the request stopped before the document's file was found.
